Subject: Prepaid credit allocation discrepancy & VAT evidence request

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

We noticed on our March statement that the prepayment of EUR 150k we made in January was applied at the consolidated level rather than being allocated across our three sub-accounts (Platform, Data Connector, and Sandbox). That left the Sandbox account with a materially higher open balance.

Two asks so we can get procurement and finance sign-off:
- Can Redwood reallocate the already-applied prepaid credit pro-rata across the three sub-accounts and reissue corrected invoices for Feb–Mar?
- For the Platform and Data Connector invoices, we need EU VAT reverse-charge evidence (our AP team requires the invoice to include the reverse-charge note and your VAT certificate). Also flag: we may have a TDS holdback for the Sandbox account in India — procurement will confirm.

I've attached the original payment receipt and the consolidated invoice excerpt (invoice-20260214.pdf, payment-schedule.csv). Procurement copied here to confirm any internal PO/DocuSign steps.

Appreciate a quick plan and timeline — our quarter close is in two weeks.

Thanks,
Priya Shah

Hi Priya — thanks for flagging this.

Short answer: yes, we can reallocate the prepaid amount pro-rata and reissue corrected invoices with the reverse-charge statement and our VAT certificate attached. We need to validate two things first:
1) The original payment's currency settlement (EUR vs USD) to ensure no FX-driven rounding differences in the reallocation.
2) Any contract/PO note that ties the payment to specific sub-accounts — if procurement used a single PO for all three, that affects how we label credit memos.

Marissa and Karthik, looping you in to run the calc and handle invoice reissue. Target: proposed allocation and a draft credit memo by EOD tomorrow so Blue Nova can route for AP approval.

I'll coordinate the DocuSign flow once we have the credit memo PDF.

Cheers,

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Prepaid credit allocation discrepancy & VAT evidence request

Investigations notes (summary):
- System root cause: the January prepayment was tagged to the master billing account instead of the three linked sub-accounts due to a metadata mapping change during the migration on 2026-01-29. The transaction id: PAY-20260114-890.
- FX: Payment received and settled in EUR. We used the bank conversion rate for 2026-01-14; reallocation will carry the same FX rate to avoid creating an additional FX gain/loss line. Rounding differences will be handled via a micro-adjustment credit (< €5).
- Tax: Platform & Data Connector invoices are EU-B2B (reverse-charge possible). Sandbox is registered in India — that account may have TDS implications.

Proposed remedy:
1) Generate a credit memo equal to the original applied credit and reapply as three credit memos allocated pro-rata by historical usage for Jan–Mar (attached: corrected-calc.xlsx).
2) Reissue corrected invoices for Feb and Mar with: reverse-charge statement on Platform/Data Connector lines, Redwood VAT certificate attached, and a note on Sandbox invoices about potential TDS (we will notate only; client to confirm withholding).
3) Create an escrowed staged release for the Sandbox credit (30% hold) until procurement confirms TDS documentation; release timeline: 5 business days after confirmations.

Attachments: corrected-calc.xlsx, proposed-credit-memo.pdf (draft).

Marissa Cole
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

- On TDS: our India ops says they will likely apply a 2% withholding on the Sandbox invoice until they have your vendor TDS certificate. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a vendor declaration or a certificate of tax residency?
- Timeline: if you can deliver the draft credit memo and corrected invoices by EOD tomorrow (Mar 19 CET), we will route for signature and pay any residual balances within our normal 10-day terms.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our quarter close depends on these corrections.

Best,
Priya
